title: Cross-family harness integration (Claude / gemini / agy / codex)
desc: How the wkharness guard stack reaches each AI family, why gemini showed false 'Hook failed' + permission prompts, and how to hard-enforce guards on gemini precisely. The hard-won 2026-06-11 playbook. Read before touching D:/GitHub/wkharness.ps1, autonomy.toml, or any cross-family hook. Cluster: -howto (implementation), -ref (the v0->v2 evolution + discoveries). Related: [[claude-md-harness-rules]].
steps: ARCHITECTURE -- one path per family, all converge on the kih guard stack (wkappbot-kih/tools/wkharness*.ps1). Claude: native PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks -> D:/GitHub/wkharness.ps1 (relay) -> kih. gemini + agy: the relay is also their BeforeTool/AfterTool hook; it ADAPTS their tool-name JSON (run_shell_command/run_command/write_file...) into Claude's tool_name format, then calls kih. codex: NO hooks -- Claude-named cmd wrappers (Write.cmd/Edit.cmd in personal-docs/tools) route through kih, so GUARDS fire but hook NUDGES do not (closed via wkharness-nudge-guide.ps1).
author: claude
